scientific_limitations: The boundary reaction convention is kappa=(D alpha/v)(1-exp(-vL/D)); the theorem is not asserted for alternative wall dynamics.
The optimization concerns spatial variance divided by L squared, at fixed v^2/(D alpha), not unnormalized spatial variance.
No uniqueness of a finite-parameter global minimizer is claimed, although all minimizers have the same asymptotic expansion.
The critical asymptotic does not cover bulk switching, interactions, or asymmetric walls.
The original 2022 stationary law implies the exact variance and is not claimed new; an equivalent unlocated optimization analysis remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Critical log–log optimization of stationary confinement in boundary-tumbling active motion
